notes.title: New version with Gallery and Achievements
notes.notes:
Dear elven-hunters.
Version 1.04 of Gorgeous Elves of Ganassa is now available and offers a [b]Gallery[/b] of your accessible puzzle-images and [b]12 Steam-achievements[/b] to unlock!
The version is currently windows-only, Mac-version is coming ASAP.
Enjoy!
